title: Former CJI BR Gavai and I were ‘Amar Prem’ of Andaz Apna Apna: Supreme Court Justice Vikram Nath
description: Supreme Court judge Justice Vikram Nath on Tuesday recalled that he and former Chief Justice of India BR Gavai were affectionately nicknamed “Amar Prem”, borrowing from the cult Bollywood film Andaz Apna Apna, during the period they regularly sat together on the Bench.Justice Nath made the remark while speaking at the launch of Justice Gavai's book, The Voice of Justice: Justice Gavai Speaks.
